snippet.title: Defrag Incremental (Whishlist on Steam!)
snippet.description:
Defrag Incremental is a retro-styled incremental strategy game about cleaning up messy drives for money, choosing the right algorithm, managing heat and wear, and building toward long-term progress.

Analyze each disk, balance risk against payout, and turn successful cleanups into stronger future runs.

Wishlist on Steam!

Demo planned in around 3 weeks.

---

Features:
- Choose between different disks/jobs with different risk, value, and fragility
- Pick the right algorithm for each cleanup
- Balance reward against heat, wear, and disk health
- Spend DP on upgrades to improve rewards, speed, and efficiency
- Build toward long-term progression through reboot and BIOS systems
- Enjoy a clean retro DOS-inspired presentation with readable pixel UI

Follow the project for updates.
